Title: Add Event Grid Trigger for Model Upload Events
Description: Implement an Event Grid subscription so FluxOps triggers when new model files are uploaded to Blob Storage. Tasks: Create Event Grid subscription; Add event handler function; Parse event schema; Add retry and dead-letter handling. Acceptance Criteria: Function triggers on blob upload; Event metadata logged.

Title: Add Durable Functions Orchestrator for ML Pipeline
Description: Implement a multi-step ML workflow using Durable Functions (train → validate → deploy). Tasks: Add orchestrator function; Add activity functions; Add status endpoint; Add fan-out/fan-in pattern. Acceptance Criteria: Orchestrator runs end-to-end; Status endpoint returns correct state.

Title: Add Redis Cache for Model Loading
Description: Replace or augment in-memory model caching with Redis for distributed caching. Tasks: Provision Redis instance; Add Redis client; Cache model bytes or metadata. Acceptance Criteria: Cache hit ratio above 50%; Fallback to Blob Storage works.

Title: Add Timer Trigger for Scheduled Retraining
Description: Add a timer-triggered function to retrain or validate models on a schedule. Tasks: Add timer trigger; Add retraining logic; Add logging. Acceptance Criteria: Timer fires on schedule; Retraining logs visible in App Insights.

Title: Add Queue Storage Trigger for Lightweight Messaging
Description: Demonstrate queue-based patterns using Azure Storage Queues. Tasks: Create queue; Add queue-triggered function; Add poison queue handling. Acceptance Criteria: Messages processed successfully; Poison queue receives failed messages.

Title: Add Custom Application Insights Telemetry
Description: Add structured logs, custom metrics, and correlation IDs to improve observability. Tasks: Add custom events; Add correlation IDs; Add structured logging. Acceptance Criteria: Custom telemetry visible in App Insights; Logs include correlation IDs.

Title: Add KQL Query Examples to Documentation
Description: Provide sample KQL queries for logs, metrics, and traces to support troubleshooting. Tasks: Add KQL examples; Add documentation section. Acceptance Criteria: KQL queries documented; Queries validated in Log Analytics.

Title: Update README with AZ-204 Objectives Reference
Description: Add reference to AZ204_OBJECTIVES.md in the README with links to exam domains. Tasks: Add section to README; Link to objectives doc; Add study strategy reference. Acceptance Criteria: Link appears in README; Navigation works correctly.
